Rip booster packs, pull foil heroes and defend your tower from endless monsters in this incremental game from zup. Out today, 30% off launch price: $6.99 until Nov 24
pic: Steam #BoosterPackHeroes #Steam #IndieGames #PCGaming https://t.co/FL6mWCr1AN

ai_tools_posts.text:
n8n Labs just launched Nod, a research preview of a personal agent that does the work around your work.

It has its own computer and browser, works in Gmail, Slack, Notion, Calendar and Drive, and talks to you in the app, on Telegram or on WhatsApp.

Free and open source. You pay https://t.co/SXFC2Hw0Jr https://t.co/bKlDyFHisq
ai_tools_posts.note: 本窗未抓到 @n8n_io 官方帖，此为互动相对较高的第三方转述：n8n Labs 推出研究预览版 Nod，开源个人 agent，自带电脑和浏览器，可用于 Gmail/Slack/Notion/Calendar/Drive，也可在应用内/Telegram/WhatsApp 对话；自选模型供应商。必须标明第三方转述，不得编造未出现的能力。
